description: Land Acquisition - Palle Aparekka, Devinuwara D/S Division, Matara District - Aparekka, Devinuwara D/S Division, Matara District - Correction to the Extra Ordinary Gazette No. 1964/58 of 28.04.2016 and 2139/52 of 04.09.2019
reasoning: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific lands being acquired by the government for public purposes, including land names, lot numbers, extents, descriptions (garden, waste land, paddy field), and claimant information. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
